question: Can exact input-free cycles supply checked nonhalting cylinders and a strict upper mass bound, while multi-read and delayed-return continuations preserve ordered input, original cost and weights?
level: External finite calibration in the existing keraia.appendix-b.cbn-whnf.read.v0 profile; no native Adva or optimal-universality claim
imports: The pinned previous tree/de Bruijn machine and string/named substitution oracle
Fair independent input bits and cylinder measure 2^(-length)
Deterministic exact-state recurrence without input yields a conditional unbounded divergence proof; the finite checker verifies all premises
interface: Receiver selects source and search allowance. A candidate contains the exact initial frame and an ordered one-step trace to a repeated full frame. Control, ordered stack, cursor, profile and cost convention are retained. The receiver independently compiles with string marking and replays beta steps by named capture-avoiding substitution. Only a positive-length cycle containing no read or return, ending after all supplied bits are consumed, certifies an entire suffix cylinder. Semantic fuel bounds discovery, not the unbounded claim's state equality.

family.sequence_data: Every binary data suffix through read_count+1 bits, including empty, underflow and overflow
cycle_controls: One read selecting this loop or I
(lambda x.(x x) x)(lambda x.(x x) x): growing stack is not an exact cycle
K I applied to the loop: discarded loop is not forced
K applied to the loop: returned lambda is not reduced underneath

checks: Both compilers agree on every distinct description and fixture
Direct and independent oracle status/read/output agree for all 65535 words at fuel 128
Prefix traversal matches the exhaustive accepted-code ledger
Accepted, certified divergent and unresolved cylinders form an exact disjoint Kraft partition
All supplied cycle edges pass an independent named-term receiver
Both branches of the one-read selector partition its input cylinder, with one accepting and one certified divergent
Every sequence fixture preserves full direct/cache/resumed records at each original fuel cut; successful full-length data consume exactly the requested number of bits
Wrongly typed or changed cycle evidence is refused; repeated head alone and hidden/discarded loops do not authorize divergence
One fresh process reproduces deterministic evidence including work counters
protected: UnknownFuel and NeedInput remain unresolved without a certificate
No arbitrary full-normalization, optimal-machine Omega, native Q4/M6, ACS commutativization, library admission or Seal
No source-weight merging, read reordering, timer renewal or arbitrary mid-step checkpoint claim
Exact-state cycle certificates are sufficient and incomplete; a growing-state loop may remain Unknown
enforcement: Shared counted-work/deadline guard includes compilation, enumeration, oracle, candidate discovery and independent certificate checking. Linux prlimit caps child CPU, memory and output; subprocess timeout caps wall time. Outer invocation has 100 wall seconds and 95 CPU seconds, including output and replay comparison. Freeze source bytes before running. Preserve any failure and require a separately written finite correction before retrying; no automatic widening.
exit: Completed fixed family, mismatch, invalid certificate, resource limit or implementation failure, retaining the exact unresolved frontier and attempt sources. No automatic subsequent search.
